c: Submitted requests lists your requests; Drafts holds what you saved.
say: Open My Requests. Submitted requests lists your requests with their state. Drafts holds what you saved for later.

c: Open an item to see its stage, price and your answers.
say: Open an item to see its stage, its price, and your answers.

c: Write in Activity or reply to an email. A closed item can't take comments.
say: To add information, write in the activity tab, or reply to an email about it. A closed item can't take comments.

c: There is no Cancel: ask the service desk on the item's Activity before delivery.
say: There is no cancel button. To cancel, ask the service desk on the item's activity tab, before it is delivered.
